MR Safety
The Rhea Pacing System is MR Conditional. A person with the Rhea Pacing System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Rhea Pacing System
Device Configuration MRI SureScan mode
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5 T
Type of Nuclei 31P (phosphorus)
MR Scanner Type Cylindrical
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 19 T/m (1,900 G/cm)
RF Coil Type head transmit/receive coil only
Receive with the head transmit/receive coil
RF Conditions Maximum Whole-Body SAR 1.5 W/kg
Scan Duration Maximum active scan time of 30 minutes. Wait 5 minutes before the next imaging session.
Scan Regions Only head and lower extremity landmarks are permitted
Image Artifact The image artifact extends approximately 3 mm from the device.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
Patients may be scanned immediately after implantation.
